chunks: "The testimony of women is not accepted regarding the sighting of the crescent; only the testimony of two just men is accepted."

key_terms.النِّسَاءِ: women, whose testimony is being discussed here
key_terms.الْهِلالِ: the new crescent moon marking the lunar month
key_terms.عَدْلَيْنِ: just and upright, possessing legal integrity

ai.seo_question: What testimony is accepted for sighting the new crescent in this hadith from Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning the establishment of the new lunar month through moon sighting. It specifies that, in this case, the accepted testimony is that of two just men.
